top_signals.title: Iron Ore Extends Weekly Drop as Excess Supply, Weak Demand Weigh
top_signals.summary: Iron ore was headed for a third straight weekly loss as ample supplies and a subdued demand outlook weighed on prices, even after Chinese trading resumed Thursday following a week-long holiday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
